name: Dr. MIT Ring
product_facts: MDA-registered male intimacy technology device (Act 737, Path B), update in progress
2 rings per box, foil sachets, reuse 3 to 5 times
Trademark DR MIT RING (R) TM2023032015 class 10
color_rules: Never white text on lime (2.45:1) or yellow on lime (1.93:1)
Yellow only as the count chip, on black only
White headings on Deep Green only for large text

rules: Place the pill on black, or as a filled black pill on lime
Never put the transparent pill directly on lime or white
Never retype, recolour or stretch the wordmark; always use the supplied file
Clear space: half the pill height; minimum 20 mm / 80 px wide
Set 'MALE INTIMACY TECHNOLOGY' (or 'M.I.T.') above the pill on packs/listings
Sign off 'Dr. MIT Ring (R) - Direka oleh SuamiSihat'

graphic_device: Ring Ripple pattern (pattern.svg): green panels only, text on solid green or black, max one third of surface, do not rotate/recolour/crop into the logo badge
photography: Product-only: packs and ring on clean off-white or textured neutral surfaces. No anatomy, no explicit or suggestive imagery.
voice: Calm and clean, clinical and confident, never crude
Instructional: short steps, clear care advice
Bahasa Malaysia first; respectful of both partners
avoid: Retired lineage references or unverified patent / medical claims
claims_status: TBC - no claims guidance supplied; regulatory sign-off pending
doctor_allowed_in_ads: yes, but only SuamiSihat-appointed doctors (see appointed_doctors). Head of Creative decision, 2026-10-16.
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), plus brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026)
staff_claims_review: Kept as reference only. The engine no longer blocks doctor use or performance wording for DMR (see decision_log).
Still screened: 'patented', 'clinically proven', 'no side effects', 'andrologically tested' (need test evidence beyond the first-article inspection).
Design-system metadata: doctor.status = pending_consent, consentRef null; MDA Path B vs Path A wording differs between metadata and claims notes.

naming.mit_meaning: M.I.T. stands for Male Intimacy Technology
naming.rule: Always write 'Dr. MIT Ring'. Where the name is explained, say M.I.T. = Male Intimacy Technology.

claims_allowed: Erection, hardness, stamina, 'tahan lama' and similar wording are allowed for DMR ads (Head of Creative decision, 2026-10-16).

evidence.what: First Article Report, Advance Micro Solutions Sdn Bhd, submitted 6 Oct 2026 for SuamiSihat Ecommerce Sdn Bhd
supports: Dimensions within tolerance on 10 samples (e.g. diameter 19.30, 32.00, 3.5, 7.30 mm); appearance and flash/burr OK; no recycled material
open_points: File the signed copy when the customer accept/reject boxes are filled in
The tooling and drawing carry a MENSS mark because the same ring is planned for a MENSS white-label (blue ring); this part is the ring used for Dr. MIT Ring too
evidence.status: Soft copy before signature; approved by management (per Head of Creative, 2026-10-16). Keep the signed copy on file.

decision_log.decision: Doctor-led DMR ads allowed, but only with SuamiSihat-appointed doctors. Performance wording allowed. 'Patented', 'clinically proven', 'no side effects', 'andrologically tested' stay screened.
decision_log.note: Brand guideline v1.0 and the staff claims review still list doctor use and these claims as pending; the engine prints a standing notice.

standing_notice: DMR decision log 2026-10-16: doctor-led ads allowed for SuamiSihat-appointed doctors only; performance wording allowed. The brand guideline v1.0 and staff claims review still list these as pending.
